title: Line endings
description:
Detect and convert line endings in a text file.

```
file A: 12 lines, CRLF (Windows)
file B: 8 lines, LF (Unix)
file C: mixed: 5 CRLF, 2 LF, 1 CR
convert C to CRLF -> 8 CRLF
```
hints: At a `\r`, look at the next character: if it is `\n`, that is one CRLF and you skip both (lesson 6.01).
Convert by normalising everything to `\n` first, then replacing `\n` with the chosen ending.
requirements: Convert to a chosen style without doubling `\r`s.
Keep a missing final line ending missing.
stretch: Detect a UTF-8 byte order mark at the start and keep it when saving.
